In addition to providing public comment in person at the meeting, the following opportunity
has been established:

Public Comment
Please email all public comment on items on this agenda only to cityclerk@sgch.org and
include the following on the subject line of your email: PUBLIC COMMENT: 01/11/2023 Special
Meeting. The Clerk will read public comment into the record for up to the three-minute limit.
Words that would disrupt the meeting, including profanity, obscenity, and discriminatory
language, will not be read. All public comments shall be e-mailed by 5:00 P.M. on meeting day.

   City Council Special Meeting Agenda
  Wednesday, January 11, 2023

 •  CALL TO ORDER
 •  ROLL CALL: Mayor Ding, Vice Mayor Harrington, Council Members Chan,
  Menchaca, Wu

 1. PUBLIC COMMENT

 2. APPOINTMENT TO THE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY MOSQUITO ABATEMENT AND
  VECTOR CONTROL DISTRICT BOARD OF TRUSTEES

  The Mayor is responsible for appointing members of the City Council to serve on various
  local and regional committees and organization boards. In addition, it is necessary for the
  Council to take formal action to appoint a representative to the San Gabriel Valley
  Mosquito and Vector Control District Board of Trustees prior to January 13, 2023 Board
  Meeting.

  CEQA Determination: Not a Project as defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines.

  Recommendation:

  The City Council is requested to appoint a representative to serve on the San
  Gabriel Valley Mosquito & Vector Control District Board of Trustees for a two-
  year term or a four-year term of office.

 3. INTERVIEWS AND APPOINTMENTS TO THE HEAR COMMISSION,
  COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION AND PLANNING COMMISSION

  The City solicited applications for vacant seats on the Community Services
  Commission and the Planning Commission with terms ending May 31, 2023; and
  three seats on the HEAR Commission with terms ending January 31, 2023. The
  Council is requested to interview the applicants and consider appointments to the
  Commissions.

  CEQA Determination: Not a Project as defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines.

  Recommendation:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:

City Council Special Meeting Agenda – January 11, 2023  2
   1. Interview applicants for the vacancy on the Community Services Commission
  and appoint one member to the Commission with a term ending May 31, 2023;
  2. Interview applicants for the Planning Commission and appoint one member to
  the Commission with a term ending May 31, 2023; and

  3. Interview applicants and appoint three members to the HEAR Commission with
  a term ending January 31, 2025.

  4. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, January 17, 2023, at
  6:30 P.M. Information regarding matters to be considered at each meeting will be
  available on the Friday before the City Council meeting on the City’s website at
  www.sangabrielcity.com.

MINUTES OF JANUARY 11, 2023
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Ding called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 5:35
  p.m. on Wednesday, January 11, 2023, in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South
  Mission Drive, San Gabriel, California, 91776.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Eric Chan, Denise Menchaca, John Wu, Vice Mayor John
  R. Harrington, and Mayor Tony Ding.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, Assistant City Attorney
  Martin Koczanowicz, Community Services Director
  Rebecca Perez, Community Development Director Aldo
  Cervantes, and Assistant City Clerk Marilyn Bonus.

  ANNOUNCEMENTS

I  Assistant City Clerk Bonus provided information for the public on how to view the meeting
  and how to request meeting agendas.

  1. PUBLIC COMMENT

  Andrew, resident, expressed concern about commissioner safety in relation to the
  vicinity map for candidate addresses in the staff report; and advocated for a youth
  advisory position on the Human Equity, Access and Relations (HEAR) Commission.

  City Manager Lazzaretto explained that the vicinity maps help to ensure a cross-
  section of the community on commissions.

  2. APPOINTMENT TO THE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY MOSQUITO ABATEMENT AND
  VECTOR CONTROL DISTRICT BOARD OF TRUSTEES

  Assistant City Clerk Bonus made the staff presentation.

  There was no public comment.
I  Discussion included details of the meeting schedule.

  A motion was made by Vice Mayor Harrington, seconded by Council Member Wu, to
  appoint Council Member Menchaca as the City's representative to the San Gabriel
  Valley Mosquito and Vector Control District Board of Trustees for a two-year term
  ending December 31, 2025.
